notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 - Improvements
notes.content: A few glaring issues I missed a while back, like trees disappearing when chopping them down and underwater screen fx have been fixed up. I only found out about these issues when I came across a recent youtube video covering our game. Embarrassing on my part to say the least, I rushed out fixes without thorough testing that ended up causing more issues. I apologise for letting these issues slip through.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 - Japanese Localisation + Improvements
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I've made some improvements as well as introduce Japanese localisation for the game's interface. Some of the improvements include lowering the weapon sway for better aiming down sight, more rocks in the spawn area to help players get started, fixed an issue with player cosmetics not letting the game start properly.

Please let me know of any further issues or things you would like to see improved. Thank you!

notes.title: 1.0.2 - Performance Improvement Patch
notes.content:
Hello everyone, great news today! This new patch today brings a significant performance increase in the game. There has been improvements made across the board for rendering and code optimisation. While there are still more improvements to come, players should expect to see much higher framerates than before.

Thank you for your patience, stay tuned for more improvements!

Japan players, we see you! Full japanese localisation is coming very soon!

notes.title: Performance Stability Hotfix
notes.content:
A small hotfix that should stabilise performance better. 

- Players should see a reduction in choppy framerate drops, should sit stably at a consistent rate.
- Work is still ongoing to raise the maximum framerate, look out for updates in the following days.

Thank you!

notes.title: Framerate Optimisation Efforts Are Underway
notes.content: Hey everyone, welcome to all our new players that have come in over the past few days! Just wanted to give a quick response to the feedback around optimisation we've seen in our recent steam reviews. We're hearing you, and I'm committing time into making every improvement possible to boost the game's overall framerate. I'll provide an update on this as soon as possible. Thank you!

notes.title: FURTIVE Leaves Early Access
notes.content:
We've just released a final update fixing a few last remaining issues and making a couple of improvements. There is also partial controller support available. As mentioned before, we made the decision to move forward with a new project rather than continue new content for FURTIVE due to a multitude of reasons. We're happy to have rounded out the last few issues, take the early access label off, drop the game price as we move into a new era for our studio. 

We're getting closer to announcing our next project that we've been working on for some time, a new kind of survival game, we're extremely looking forward to bringing it to your attention soon. Please follow our social media pages or subscribe to our newsletter at [url=https://frozenbulletgames.com]https://frozenbulletgames.com[/url] to receive the announcement when its ready.

Thank you FURTIVE players, we'll see you in our next game soon!

notes.title: Dev Update - June 12th
notes.content:
Hey everyone, Dev Update!

Just a little update about the next update. Since releasing Call To Arms Part I, we've had to scale back our efforts to take a small break for ourselves and we've had time to reconsider how we will be approaching our future plans. First, we're going to be pushing back the content we were planning to release this month to a later point for now, but we're doing this to ensure we're delivering a satisfying content update that comes with as little issues as possible, and so that we have time to improve other areas that need attention as well. So you can expect the features we had planned and more for the next content update.

Before then, we want to prioritise controller support and localisation so we can broaden our player base and bring more players into our community in time for the next content update. We believe bringing full controller support can come with many opportunities such as putting our game on the Steam Deck and even porting to consoles one day.

This means there will be a shift in all future plans we originally had but we'll touch more on that at a later point in time. Thanks for all the support everyone, we'll share our progress soon!

notes.title: FURTIVE v0.2.1 - Call To Arms Update Fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we've just deployed a patch that fixes a range of issues found in the Call To Arms Part I update. There's more patches to come as we learn about these issues, please let us know if you experience any we might not have heard about yet.

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Buffed the HV-1 winch strength and increased it's maximum length.
[*] Optimised health code to minimise game freezing on death.
[*] Fixed a bug where the third person's gun model parts and muzzle flashes would be rendered in the first person camera after exiting a vehicle.
[*] Fixed a bug where the mission to steal a HV-1 was not completable and caused the game to stop working correctly.
[*] Fixed the road collisions near the outpost that leads to the main facility bridge.
[*] Fixed NavMesh around the fortresses so soldiers and animals are no longer able to spawn or walk inside the walls.
[*] Fixed a bug where the HV-1 was still drive-able after it had run out of fuel.
[*] Adjusted helicopter spawnrate to be slightly less frequent.
[*] Helicopter will now flee if it is unsuccessful in finding players after a while.
[*] Adjusted textures on Chris Roberts and Aaron Roberts default and survivor outfits, as well as all Corocotta disguises to prevent them clipping in the camera.
[*] The fortress floors now give the correct footstep sound effects.
[/list]

Thanks everyone!

notes.title: CALL TO ARMS PART I - FURTIVE v0.2.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41181979/7bcc1069dd21bc7b4e5bda8cbff6f8198ea720d7.png[/img]
Welcome to the Call To Arms update! Part 1 of 2 of the new content and features coming to FURTIVE. The second part will be releasing some time in June.

Please note we strongly recommend starting a new save file for this update.

[b]New Content Additions[/b]
[list]
[*] Weapon Attachments: Added attachments for all guns (excluding Rocket Launcher), including Silencer, Red Dot Sight, Reflex Sight, Halo Sight, and ACOG Scope.
[*] HV-1 Winch: Introduced a new winch feature for the HV-1 vehicle to help it get unstuck.
[*] Steam Achievements: Implemented 60 new achievements.
[*] Building Items: Added new items including Table, Standing Torch, and Sleeping Bag.
[*] Map Points of Interest: Added 2 new Fuel Depots and 2 new Corocotta Fortresses.
[*] Weapon Crates: New weapon crates can be found in Outposts, Fortresses, and Supply Boats. These crates may contain weapons like Rapidhawk SMG, Hunting Rifle, Galil, IS-1911, as well as attachments and ammunition.
[*] Cosmetic Outfits: Introduced a new set of 'Survivor' outfits for all 4 characters.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41181979/953a7450a1ff41f1058d21cc705e8dfc3b1813c5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41181979/5ba333c3ac3f376ae54d99e0ca0a913cf4097e55.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41181979/ffe32841203261920459260da9fac1d855c428b5.png[/img]

[b]Changes and Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Workbench V2: Updated the workbench with a new UI, allowing players to craft items, change firearm attachments, and repair melee weapons/tools.
[*] Item Degradation: Melee weapons and tools now degrade with use and can be repaired at the workbench.
[*] Weapon Info UI: Reworked the bottom right UI to display ammunition type for firearms and a health bar for melee weapons.
[*] Rucksack Model: Added a visible rucksack model to the player character's back when their inventory contains items.
[*] Inventory Rucksacks: Redesigned the death drop rucksacks to spawn on the server, interactable by all players as normal storage containers, with an improved UI for item management. These rucksacks now also save and load correctly.
[*] Weapon Icon Artwork: Updated all weapon icons to match the style of other items.
[*] Metal Axe Model: Upgraded the model for the Metal Axe.
[*] Aiming Adjustments: Lowered the camera field of view when aiming down sights to improve aiming accuracy. Additionally, weapon walk animations now do not play when aiming down sights.
[*] Supply Crates: Removed the ability to add items back into supply crates.
[*] Tree Generation Option: Added an option to generate fewer trees when creating a new save to enhance performance.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41181979/2566600a641ce639a9d93dda99401f570aa3cbb9.png[/img]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] HV-1 Mission Crash: Fixed a crash that occurred when completing missions while inside the HV-1.
[*] HV-1 Crouch Bug: Fixed a bug where entering the HV-1 while crouching caused it to flip when exiting.
[*] Galil Model: Optimized the Galil weapon model.
[*] Fire Particles: Fixed transparency issues of fire particles against fog.
[*] Map Errors: Corrected errors in certain map locations.
[/list]

[b]Work In-Progress Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Framerate Optimisation: We're still working on ways to improve framerate. The Part II update will feature further optimisations of in-game assets around the new points of interest.
[*] Furnace Items: Addressing inconsistencies when adding to or removing items from the furnace.
[*] Dialogue Voice Volume: Slightly adjusted dialogue voice volume, but we're continuing to work on achieving a better balance.
[*] Wood Footstep Sounds: Fixing the issue where wood footstep sounds are incorrectly applied when walking on terrain around wood pillars.
[*] Client Control of the HV-1: Ongoing work to resolve issues with client control of the HV-1.
[/list]

Our discord server now features a new bot with commands to report bugs and suggest features that will give users a prompt to fill out. These reports will go straight to our development dashboard so we can work fast to address it and provide updates as we go along. [url=https://discord.gg/8DfSaxQ]Join the discord![/url]

Thank you! We look forward to hearing about your experience with the new update.

notes.title: CALL TO ARMS PART I - MAY 28th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41181979/8f8c1b9b39c9f71754dd89e2b7a0447ce082367a.png[/img]

CALL TO ARMS PART I. Kicking off on May 28th in Steam's Open World Survival Craft Fest.

We've had to split May's update in half due to the scope of update creeping higher than we initially intended, the second half will be coming around 3 weeks or so after the first part releases.

Part I Features: Weapon Attachments, HV-1 Winch, Melee Weapon/Tool Degradation and Repairing, Workbench V2, New Map Points of Interest, 60 Steam Achievements, New Unlockable Character Outfits.

Part II Features (Coming Soon): New Village NPC that provides Raid Missions quests, HV-1 Refueling, Weather System, Map Locations Markers and Craftable Waypoint Markers.

Both parts will also feature some bug fixes and improvements.

See you all soon!

Another improvement also being made to firearms is we've taken out the walking animation while aiming down sights to keep the weapon steady, we're also lowering the FOV while aiming which will significantly improve the ADS experience when using the firearms.

notes.title: FURTIVE v0.1.6
notes.content:
[b]Release Notes[/b]
[list]
[*] Client players can now interact ride in the HV-1 as passenger, currently only hosting player can drive the vehicle. We are still fixing an issue with the client's ability to drive the vehicle.
[*] Save file stability in new updates has been improved with a new save file upgrading function in the save system.
[*] Breaking tree stumps will no longer break multiplayer sessions.
[*] Items near other players no longer glow for the local player.
[*] Interaction range has been slightly increased so players can pick up items and interact with objects from a slightly further distance.
[*] Characters will now properly unlock when the player using them disconnects, leaving the character free to be chosen by the next joining player.
[*] Fixed corrupted metal axe icon in the equipped weapon display on the bottom right corner of screen.
[/list]

Another issue we have recently picked up is the save and load system won't consistently load players back into their position they saved in, instead just go back to spawn. We're investigating the cause for this, but other than that everything else loads correctly.

notes.title: Upcoming Content Sneak Peak.
notes.content:
Let's take a peak into what's coming soon this year. We'd like to share what we are bringing to the game in May's update and give a little tease to what will be happening in August.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41181979/a9f934ba499b6a0f626ba16a37b26b7c7952eb1b.png[/img]
[b]CALL TO ARMS - May Content/Quality of Life Update[/b]
This update plans to include a complete rework to the Workbench, improving it's UI and functionality. This station will not only be used for crafting anymore, it will now also be used for repairing weapons/tools as we plan to introduce degradation, and last but not least, customising firearm attachments. Firearms will receive a range of attachments to apply improvements on your selected firearm.

Map Location Markers. Newly discovered locations will become marked on the player's GPS to help with familiarising yourself with the map as you discover it. Player's will also be able to craft waypoint markers to drop behind in locations they wish to remember to come back to, such as bases.

Raid Missions. We plan to introduce a new NPC in the night crawler group at the active night villages. Offering rewards for completing small strike missions to cripple The Corocotta and help the group with their needs. Rewards will include gold, xp and any loot you obtain from the mission.

There's a lot more to coming with this update that we'll go into more detail on as we get closer. These are just some of the main highlights.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41181979/ac817c8d7c98697c629e875ed5571e9ccc3cecd7.png[/img]
[b]VERDANT SECTOR - August Content Expansion[/b]
We've also begun early production on August's major content update. We call this an expansion as we plan to expand the map in a pretty big and unconventional way, with plenty of interesting areas to explore, new missions to do, new weapons to obtain, new enemies to face, and more. We'll touch more on this a little bit later.

Can't wait to share more of the upcoming content with you all. Massive thank you to everyone for the incredible support in our first few weeks of launch!

notes.title: FURTIVE v0.1.5 Patch Release
notes.content:
[b]Release Notes[/b]
[list]
[*] Major performance stuttering has been fixed. Our next steps will be to achieve a higher FPS.
[*] Added buoyancy to items in lakes, which should rectify the issue of not being able to pick up items under water. Items can be picked up once they have surfaced.
[*] Added a new skill tree for upgrading inventory capacity up to 100, mastery level lets players keep their toolbar items after death.
[*] Added repair functionality to the building hammer, allowing the player to repair damaged structures using 1 wood log per third of maximum health of the building object.
[*] Changed Toolbar UI placement in the inventory item window to be more prominent, with an added header.
[*] Adjusted spawnrates of soldiers, wildlife, helicopter patrols, and boats. Let us know if these rates need further tweaking.
[*] Soldier's attack priority between players and buildings has been adjusted to prioritise the player more. Let us know if they still tend to target buildings more.
[*] Removed forced opening prologue for first time players. You will now only be prompted once when clicking play in the menu, asking if you wish to play the prologue or not.
[*] Trees now fall in the direction the player is facing when chopping them.
[*] Fixed missing stump texture underneath cut trees.
[*] Menu screen buttons now hightlight when hovering the mouse over and clicking.
[*] Fixed a bug where The Trader NPC would spontaneously attack the player.
[*] Added a check to prevent removing items from furnaces/campfires if the player's inventory is full.
[*] Soldiers/Wildlife will no longer take damage from vehicles that have no players inside, and the minimum impact damage has been increased so they don't die too easily when touching vehicles.
[/list]

[b]Ongoing Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Performance drop while wielding building hammer.
[*] UI Markers clipping out after 1000m.
[*] HV-1 Interaction for client players.
[*] Still looking for any further multiplayer bug reports so that we may address them promptly.
[/list]

notes.title: FURTIVE v0.1.3 Patch Release
notes.content:
A big patch today fixing a range of issues and adding some quality of life improvements. Final missions are now fixed and re-enabled!

[b]Release Notes[/b]
[list]
[*] Upgraded project to Unity 2022.3.22f1 LTS from 2021.2.5f1
[*] Final missions issues have been resolved and re-enabled.
[*] HV-1 no longer collide with plant objects.
[*] HV-1 SFX has been improved to include acceleration audio.
[*] HV-1 handling has been tweaked, please provide feedback on how it feels to drive now.
[*] Bears and Tigers have added SFX.
[*] Inventory count is now present in the crafting page.
[*] Added a reload state to all Soldiers wielding guns, they will have a limited amount of shots before needing to reload for a few seconds. This should allow players to time their strikes, especially when using melee weapons.
[*] Added the ability to drink water from ponds/lakes, it will provide a small amount of hydration whilst damaging the player a little bit as the water is dirty.
[*] Fixed an issue where player could not gather water with empty buckets from ponds/lakes
[*] GPS can now also be found in supply crates.
[*] Strength skill tree mastery level now applies instant takedown on melee weapons properly.
[*] Inventory related sound effects (eating, drinking, etc) will no longer layer up. They will only play one sound at a time.
[*] Wooden storage crates will now drop all items inside when salvaged with the building hammer.
[*] Cut the first wave out of helicopter raids to improve the pacing of the raid event.
[*] Fixed pistol weilding soldiers/captains aiming pose, they now aim directly at the player correctly.
[*] Fixed collisions in facilities.
[*] Improvements have been made to certain areas on the map.
[*] Selected characters in multiplayer will now be more apparent that they are already taken.
[/list]

[b]Still Investigating[/b]
[list]
[*] Pressing Alt + Tab during game saving has been reported to cause issues saving.
[*] HV-1 Interaction for client players.
[*] Multiplayer bugs - we need more information on any issues that arise during multiplayer.
[*] Tracking markers disappearing after 1000m range
[/list]

As usual, a huge thank you for all the feedback coming our way. Please continue to bring on the feedback. We will now be getting started on the upcoming content update in May, fixes will still rollout in the meantime.

notes.title: FURTIVE now releasing 29 March 2024
notes.content:
FURTIVE will now be releasing in Early Access 29 March 2024. Stay tuned on our socials for more posts coming over the next few weeks.

This is a delay from our 2023 release plans we wanted to stick to, but meeting that time frame became more and more unrealistic due to the remaining workload. We are however completely locked in on this date and have begun doing more non-remote work sessions together to achieve this goal. We have chosen to go with an Early Access release to give a period of time for us to act on player feedback related directly to any issues we missed in testing and such, we expect to be out of it as soon as we are satisfied with the state of the launch build, and of course we will continue to grow the game from there.

In terms of testing we wanted to plan another playtest as soon as we can, so for players interested in that we will have news for you very soon. Thanks everyone!

notes.title: Next Fest Demo Concluded
notes.content:
As the Next Fest now comes to an end, so does our Next Fest Demo. We want to thank everyone who took the time throughout the week to give our game a try and provide us with the much needed feedback. We've read through every single piece of feedback we could find and already have written down our plans to address all of it as we continue to develop our game further.

Although we can agree on the big flaws found in our demo, we truly believe we've got great things coming. This has been a big learning experience for us, we've had big takeaways from it and we are really grateful for everyone's insight that has helped us.

We promise nothing will be released in the same kind of state as our demo. We want to make sure that our product will be top quality, content packed, and with minimal issues. We will do anything to achieve our goal even if it might mean delaying our game further, we believe your satisfaction with our product comes first before anything.

Thank you again, please follow our social channels such as our twitter, instagram or discord to see our progress updates as we develop our game!

notes.title: Feedback Response + Development Roadmap
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we've read through all the feedback we've received regarding our demo. We want to apologise for any poor experiences that may have occurred. What you are mostly seeing in the demo is the groundwork that's being laid which we are getting ready to expand upon. But with that there are also some outstanding issues that need to be addressed from performance, to filling the world with more interesting locations and interactable objects. 

We have a lot of plans that we weren't able to achieve before the demo, we got too ahead of ourselves and were excited to bring you a playable experience to try as soon as we could. But we see we didn't hit the mark we wanted to at all. All the feedback we received is being taken into account and we will be working hard to elevate the experience to a much higher standard to bring you the type of game that is enjoyable for you to play.

With that, here is our roadmap of the things we are working up until our release.

There is still much more to come with all the changes we want to make based on the feedback you've provided. Hopefully this news comes as something you want to hear and would be willing to give us another chance later down the line.

Thank you everyone!
